m5-gps-dhc.intro:
Bursting with game-enhancing technology, the all-new 2026 Motocaddy M5 GPS DHC combines advanced GPS intelligence with automatic downhill control, delivering total confidence and precision on even the most demanding courses.

At the heart of the M5 GPS DHC is a crystal-clear 3.5” touchscreen display, providing fast, accurate, high-performance GPS in a highly responsive format. The latest automotive-inspired styling introduces 10-spoke low-profile tyres, refined neutral trim, and newly redesigned ergonomic handle grips for a sleek, premium finish.
m5-gps-dhc.more:
Re-engineered with next-generation GPS technology and extensive customisation options, the M5 GPS DHC allows you to switch seamlessly between 2D and 3D mapping views. A new 2D pan and zoom function, combined with movable target positioning, enables precise shot planning, while cutting-edge 3D hole flyovers deliver enhanced insight before every tee shot. Customisable shortcuts keep your most-used features within easy reach, with the option to hide shortcut bars or rotate into landscape mode for an optimised viewing experience. New dark and light display modes ensure excellent visibility in all playing conditions.

With over 40,000 pre-loaded courses, the M5 GPS DHC provides front, middle, and back-of-green distances, detailed hazard information, and full-hole mapping with drag-and-drop target positioning. A comprehensive suite of high-tech features includes Bluetooth® smartphone notifications, super-fast Wi-Fi over-the-air updates, and free lifetime access to full-hole GPS mapping and performance tracking.

Engineered to handle undulating terrain with ease, the M5 GPS DHC is powered by a lightweight, high-capacity CLICK ‘N’ CONNECT® cable-free lithium battery, featuring patented auto-disconnect technology and a convenient pop-up charging port. Automatic Downhill Control (DHC) intelligently regulates speed on descents, working in harmony with rugged all-terrain DHC tyres and an electronic parking brake to keep the trolley securely in position on both uphill and downhill slopes while you play your shot.

  • 3.5” crystal-clear touchscreen display

m1.intro:
Meet the all-new 2026 Motocaddy M1 – the world’s easiest-to-use compact electric trolley, redesigned with smarter features, a sleeker look, and effortless performance from the first tee to the last green.

Built around an ultra-compact folding system, the M1 sets up and packs away in seconds, making transport and storage refreshingly simple. At the handle, a new 2.8” LCD widescreen display delivers crystal-clear visibility, with nine speed settings so you can dial in the perfect pace for your walk.
m1.more:
The automotive-inspired styling is complemented by sporty 10-spoke wheels, subtle trim accents, and newly contoured ergonomic grips for enhanced comfort. The vibrant display keeps everything you need in view, including a clock, round timer, and three distance readouts covering drive, round, and lifetime totals. For added peace of mind, the new Cartlock security PIN helps protect your trolley when not in use.

Power comes from Motocaddy’s high-capacity CLICK ‘N’ CONNECT® cable-free lithium battery, featuring patented auto-disconnect technology and a convenient pop-up charging port. Combined with a next-generation 28V high-power system and a whisper-quiet 230W motor, the M1 delivers smooth, reliable performance with impressive efficiency.

Packed with practical touches, the M1 includes adjustable handle height to suit golfers of all sizes, a USB charging port to keep devices powered during your round, and Adjustable Distance Control, allowing the trolley to travel up to 45 yards ahead in set increments. Like all Motocaddy trolleys, it’s also EASILOCK® compatible, ensuring a fast, secure bag connection without a lower strap.

navee-birdie-3x.intro:
Clip the remote to your belt, set off, and let your trolley follow you. Genuinely hands-free golf.

The NAVEE Birdie 3X is the trolley for golfers who want the complete experience. Ultra-precise UWB auto-follow keeps it tracking right behind you as you walk, remote control takes over whenever you want to send it ahead, and smart power assist is there when you'd rather walk with it. Add 36-hole battery life, a one-touch fold and a 5-year registered battery warranty, and you have premium follow technology at a price that makes it genuinely accessible.
navee-birdie-3x.more:
Why Golfers Choose the Birdie 3X

Hands-Free Auto-Follow Press the button, clip the remote to your belt and walk. Powered by ultra-precise UWB (Ultra-Wideband) positioning, the Birdie 3X stays right by your side, leaving your hands free and your mind on the game.

Three Ways to Play Switch between auto-follow, remote control and smart power assist to suit the hole, the terrain or how you feel on the day.

Instant Remote Control Go, stop or turn with a single tap. Send it ahead down the fairway and it reacts instantly to every command.

Smart Power Assist Press and hold the red buttons on one or both handles and the Birdie 3X takes the weight, adjusting its assistance in real time to your walking pace for natural support up slopes and through rough ground.

Dual-Drive Traction for Any Course Two independent rear-drive brushless motors handle firm fairways, muddy rough and inclines of up to 25%, with consistent power and precise handling.

Up to 36 Holes on One Charge A high-efficiency 220Wh battery manages power intelligently to see you through two full rounds.

Quick One-Touch Fold Folds in a single movement to just 68 x 56.5 x 38.4cm (around 0.15m³) - smaller than a standard golf bag - for easy transport and storage.

Full Control from Your Phone The free NAVEE smart app lets you adjust speed, check battery life, track your scores and customise settings.

Stable on All Terrain Widened 11-inch tyres grip confidently while minimising fairway impact, and the 4+1 wheel system with a detachable anti-tip wheel keeps everything stable.

What's Included

  • NAVEE Birdie 3X electric trolley with battery
  • UWB remote control
  • Phone holder
  • Umbrella holder
  • Charger

Bonus: 12 Months of Hole19 Premium

Every Birdie 3X comes with a free 12-month Hole19 Premium subscription, worth £59.99 - adding course GPS and game tracking to your round. Offer subject to NAVEE's terms.

Frequently Asked Questions

How does the follow function work? Clip the UWB remote to your belt and the Birdie 3X tracks its position, following behind you as you walk. It performs best with the remote worn at belt height.

Can I still use it as a remote or push trolley? Yes. The Birdie 3X switches between auto-follow, remote control and smart power assist whenever you like.

How many holes will the battery last? The 220Wh battery is rated for up to 36 holes on a single charge.

Can it handle hilly courses? Yes. Its dual rear-drive motors are designed to climb inclines of up to 25%.

What's the difference between the Birdie 3X and Birdie 3? Both share the same motors, battery, fold and app. The Birdie 3X adds UWB auto-follow for a fully hands-free round.

With a 220Wh battery that runs for up to 36 holes and a 5-year registered battery warranty, it's built to take the effort out of walking the course for seasons to come.

Instant Remote Control Go, stop or turn with a single tap. The Birdie 3 reacts instantly, so you can send it ahead down the fairway and keep your focus on the next shot.

Smart Power Assist Press and hold the red buttons on one or both handles and the Birdie 3 takes the weight. It adjusts its assisting force in real time to match your walking pace, giving natural support up slopes and through rough ground.

Dual-Drive Traction for Any Course Two independent rear-drive brushless motors handle firm fairways, muddy rough and inclines of up to 25%, delivering consistent power and precise handling where you need it most.
